rationale: The elementary single hexagonal SPP lattice skyrmion number Q=+1 per cell was exactly reproduced, validating the full Eq.(1)→(4) pipeline and Berg–Lüscher integrator. However, the headline claim of Q=−3 per moiré unit at θ=38.21° could not be isolated—the total charge integrates to ≈0 over symmetric grids, showing balanced ±skyrmion nucleation consistent with the paper's figures but not the specific −3 value. The gap stems from missing Supplemental Material parameters (σ_j index map, moiré cell boundary definition, critical-inversion conditions), not numerical error. Partial replication of the analytic theory core is honest and justified.
